text.zh: 膝盖往两边打开，屁股慢慢往后坐
text.en: Spread your knees wide and slowly sit your hips back

text.zh: 小臂撑地，脚尖朝外，背放平。
text.en: Forearms down, toes out, back flat.

text.zh: 小腿和膝盖贴地，脚踝跟膝盖一条线。
text.en: Shins and knees on the floor, ankles in line with knees.

text.zh: 呼气时屁股往后坐一点点，大腿内侧有拉就停。
text.en: Each breath out, rock your hips back a touch. Stop at a clear inner-thigh stretch.

commonErrors.en: Forcing your hips to go wider.

commonErrors.zh: 屁股猛往后坐，大腿内侧扯着疼
commonErrors.en: Rocking back too hard so your inner thighs hurt.

cautions.zh: 膝盖下面垫软垫，膝盖不舒服就别再分开
cautions.en: Pad under your knees. If they feel off, don't go any wider.

cautions.zh: 大腿内侧疼就少往后坐点，别让别人帮你压
cautions.en: If your inner thighs hurt, don't sit back as far. Never let someone push you down.
